scope_note: High-confidence, publicly disclosed U.S. Meta energy agreements and utility-backed generation relevant to current AI/data-center buildout. This v1 is intentionally not a claim of exhaustiveness across Meta's full global portfolio.

campuses.name: Hyperion
campuses.load_proxy_basis: Meta announced 5 GW of compute capacity. Public meter-level electrical load is not disclosed; compute MW is used only as a directional proxy.

campuses.name: Prometheus
campuses.load_proxy_basis: Meta describes Prometheus as a 1 GW AI cluster. Public meter-level electrical load is not disclosed; compute MW is used only as a directional proxy.

notes: Capacity factor is used only to estimate annual energy, not capacity adequacy.
Firm factor is a simple public-data proxy, not MISO/PJM accredited capacity, ELCC or UCAP.
Solar rows disclosed only in MWdc are excluded from normalized MWac totals until an AC rating is available.
Battery MW is power capacity, not annual generation; duration and dispatch determine energy contribution.
v2 firm scenarios are screening ranges used to test portfolio sensitivity. They are not market-specific accredited capacity values.
v2 portfolio health is an explainable composite intended to prioritize investigation, not to certify portfolio adequacy.
Campus timeline compares cumulative public supply by COD year with announced ultimate compute scale; it does not invent a facility demand ramp.
assumptions.health_score_note: Screening score only. It is an explainable learning construct, not a Meta KPI, ISO accreditation metric, or investment-grade risk model.
